method: Direct viewing of each of the four existing exported PNG files through view_image. No new render, image manipulation, reconstruction, or image generation.
scope: Qualitative initial-image review only. The static image observations are independent from PNG hash identity checks and do not certify native simulation completion, contact, deformation realism, or task success. Camera-category agreement is approximate, not pixel-matched to the supplied reference images.

direct_visual_inspection.observations: Elevated oblique view shows the entire tabletop working area and both arms. Bag body lies flat across the tabletop; the two handles extend from its mouth with a small local curl. Teddy lies beside the bag with face and belly visible upward. Both robot bodies, bag, and teddy fit inside the image. Lower table legs extend beyond the bottom edge, which does not crop a task subject.
